head: codex/35-codex-background-task-dispatch
title: [tooling] Prove bounded Codex background dispatch (#35)
body:
Closes #35

## Summary

- run one bounded project-discovery probe and one projectless no-op dispatch canary
- retain sanitized digest-bound inventory, readback, and ownership evidence
- document success, reconciliation, retry, escalation, upstream ownership, and non-claims
- add no ADL product code, scheduler, claim, lease, heartbeat, or retry wrapper

## Validation

- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/35/validate-dispatch-evidence.rb evidence`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/35/validate-dispatch-evidence.rb docs`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/35/validate-dispatch-evidence.rb review`
- `csdlc-validate --root . issue --issue 35`
- `git diff --check`
- independent exact-revision review: PASS, zero findings

The canary proves the current bounded happy path; it does not claim every historical UI hang is globally fixed.
